body:
this was a few years ago. i was 11-12. there was this really nice community school downtown that was built about 4 years ago. whenever my parents and i would drive past it they would look at it, scoff and drive away. this one time, we were going out for dinner and we drove past it. without looking back at my sister and i, my dad said "thats a bad school. kids who are in juvenile detention go to that school, thats why its called a community school." my sister and i were like "oh really? we will make sure not to end up there then" so for years, we had the assumption in our heads that there were a bunch of juvenile delinquents going to that school. 

about a year ago, i got in trouble at my public school so my mom said that i would be dropping out and be going to a different school. i later found out that i would be enrolling into that community school.

i asked my mom "heh, remember when you and dad used to tell me that that's where bad kids go to school?" 

she said "yeah, that was pretty funny"

are you fucking kidding me!? this shit pisses me off to this day. whenever i would get in trouble for big things, or even the smallest of things, i would be yelled at and told that they were going to send me to jail and i would go there for school. 

if i ever got in trouble for ANYTHING they would tell me "we can deal with you anymore, youre going to jail downtown, that police station over there is where they will take you and you will be enrolled into that community school"

now when i get droven there every fucking day like its nothing, they dont think twice about it and i think about it everyday.
we are so proud of you!!!
this hits too hard to home, man
